_doc: Duchess Malphine of the Ashen Court. Speaks through Pip's letters until the Empty Throne is known; then she comes to Basecamp in person (StoryHooks spawns her). Pool 'malphine'.

lines.text: So this is the war camp. It smells exactly as I was told. Do not tell Pip I came. He will want to carry my train.
You are the Sinbound who found out about the chair. Clever thing. Cleverness is so rarely useful in a weapon.

choices.text: I am not your weapon, Duchess.
Then point me at the Gate.

lines.label: not
lines.text: Everyone is somebody's weapon, darling. The trick is choosing who holds you.

lines.label: point
lines.text: Good. Obedience and ambition, in the same body. How very Hell of you.
Yes, I have had a cushion made. For the Throne. Velvet, ash grey, embroidered with my crest.
One should always be prepared to sit down. You may carry it up for me, if you like.
Pip has been reading my letters. Pip always reads my letters. It is why I write them.
Now you know what the Court intends. So the only question left is what you intend.
To climb faster than you can follow.
...Delicious. Go on, then.
Do not kneel. It creases the ash.
Heaven is a house with no master, darling. Houses like that always end up with a new one.
I never accept gifts. I accept tribute. The difference is posture. Press G, darling.
Lilaeth, darling. Fallen and still so poised. You must give me lessons.
Morvane. You have my name in that book. I have yours in mine. Shall we call it even?
Warden. The Court remembers who keeps its prisoners. And who could release them.
Must you stand like that? Everyone knows you have horns, darling.
Ysolde. You make the dukes nervous. Keep doing it.
Darling, you are dripping on my hem. No. Keep dripping. It is very avant-garde.
Iscariel, darling. Hell's most famous defector. The Court adores you. Nobody trusts you. Ideal.
Iscariel. You betrayed Heaven. The Court wonders, idly, whether you would betray Hell.
I betrayed a door, Duchess, not a side. I would do it again to any door that keeps people in.
Then I shall make sure my doors are always open, darling. Especially to you.
